name: moodler-mcp
description: Moodle LMS MCP server. Sign in once, then browse courses, assignments, grades, forums, messages and files from your Moodle instance via AI assistants.
long_description:
moodler-mcp connects your AI assistant to your own Moodle instance so you can ask natural-language questions about your coursework.

**What you can do**

- *"What's due this week?"* — pulls deadlines from your calendar and assignment list.
- *"What do I need to do for my INT212 project?"* — reads the assignment page and returns the full spec.
- *"Why are my grades in INT201 low?"* — reads your grade report and summarises what's posted.
- *"Download the week 4 lecture slides and summarise them."* — downloads the PDF and reads it directly, handing local clients the file itself.
- *"Find student Jane Doe in the CS department."* — teacher-facing student search when you're logged in as staff.

Authentication happens once: the login_to_moodle tool opens a browser window for your institution's single sign-on, then stores a Moodle web service token locally (the same kind the official Moodle app uses). Every later call uses Moodle's REST API with that token; no browser, no cookies, no scraping. No telemetry, no external transmission beyond your own Moodle instance. See the privacy policy for details.

moodle_url.title: Moodle URL
moodle_url.description: Base URL of your Moodle instance (e.g. https://moodle.example.edu), no trailing slash. Run the login_to_moodle tool once after installing; a browser opens for single sign-on and a token is stored locally.

allow_student_writes.title: Allow student writes
allow_student_writes.description: Enable tools that submit assignments, post forum replies, send messages, mark notifications read, tick completion and create personal calendar events. Each destructive action asks for confirmation.

allow_teacher_grading.title: Allow teacher grading
allow_teacher_grading.description: Enable tools that save assignment grades and grant extensions. Only useful for staff accounts. Each action asks for confirmation.
